description: Character + SentencePiece BPE/Unigram tokenizer baselines for Chichewa Corpus v0.1. Train on frozen train split only.

normalization.notes: No aggressive Chichewa normalization. Prefer identity. SentencePiece uses normalization_rule_name=identity.

roles.<pad>: Padding for batching; not used during tokenizer training metrics.
roles.<bos>: Beginning of sequence (optional at encode time).
roles.<eos>: End of sequence (optional at encode time).

sentencepiece.seed_note: sentencepiece 0.2.0 TrainerSpec has no seed field; determinism via shuffle_input_sentence=false, num_threads=1, full corpus, fixed config.
notes: shuffle_input_sentence=false for order-stable training over the full train corpus.
character_coverage=1.0 to retain rare Unicode including ŵ.
byte_fallback=false: unknown pieces surface as <unk> rather than byte pieces.
BPE and Unigram share these settings; only model_type differs.
Explicit pad/unk/bos/eos piece strings are set to <pad>/<unk>/<bos>/<eos> (not SentencePiece defaults <s>/</s>).

criteria: lower fertility preferred among subword models (not compared to character as winner)
avoid excessive whole-line memorization (very large average token length + low fertility at huge vocab)
practical embedding size (prefer smaller among near-ties)
balanced bible vs wikipedia fertility gap not extreme
selection_rubric.weights_note: Multi-criteria qualitative score on validation; not a single metric. Test evaluated only after selection.
